description: Plan a single round or a whole golf trip. Greenfee365 searches live tee times and green fee prices at more than 1,400 bookable golf courses, from the Costa del Sol and the Algarve to Scotland, Thailand and the UAE. Ask for a course, a city or a destination and get the times that are genuinely available, the price per player in local currency and how many spots are left. Prices come straight from the Greenfee365 booking platform, so what you see is what the course is selling right now, not an estimate. When you have found your time you get a link to greenfee365.com with date and party size already filled in, and you complete the booking there. No account needed to search.
